question: How many unused PTO days can I carry over into next year?
answer: You may carry over up to 5 unused PTO days into the next calendar year. [1] If you were unable to take PTO because of sickness or parental leave, you may carry over all unused days, which must be used within 12 months of your return to work. [2]
gold_answer: Up to 5 days, used by 31 March.
